Marzouk, O.A. (2025). Solar Heat for Industrial Processes (SHIP): An Overview of Its Categories and a Review of Its Recent Progress. Solar 5(4): 46. https://doi.org/10.3390/solar5040046

Descriptive review with NO cost, LCOH, lifetime or TRL data; the author states cost analysis is out of scope (Sect. 5, Discussion and Conclusions, limitations). Loaded only temperature limits by collector group (Tables 1-2 and Sect. 1.1 text); these are classification boundaries and CSP-context maxima, so treat them as weak. Deployment statistics (Tables 7-8) and two single-study numbers from Table 6 go to other-values. Page numbers are printed page numbers (n of 38), equal to PDF pages. Coordinator may prefer to treat this source as background.
